name: file_dup3
prototype: int file_dup3(struct file *source, struct file *target, int flags)

ownership.argument: Astrolink calls this as F_FILE_DUP3(source, &own_file, 0) to take an independent reference to the loop pipe write end before releasing the task file-list reference.

provenance.source: Rejects flags other than 0 and 0x400 (the a3 & ~0x400 test), closes the destination through file_close 0xC1CEC08, copies the source flags, offset and inode (file+16) into the destination, takes the inode lock via 0xC1BA04C, then dispatches the inode type-3 open handler at ops+48 or the character-device open at ops+0 before releasing the reference.

notes: Astrolink calls this as F_FILE_DUP3(source, &own_file, 0) to take an independent reference to the loop pipe write end before releasing the task file-list reference.
